read.thesis: P&G Q2 FY26 organic sales flat with volume down 1% and North America down 2%; FY guidance held (organic 0-4%, core EPS 0-4%), with no supply-side signal and restructuring exits a 30-50bp headwind.

capex.quote: this includes an increase in capital spending as we add capacity in several categories

triggers.label: North America organic sales down 2%
triggers.quote: Organic sales in North America were down 2%.

triggers.label: Base-period trade inventory ~2pt NA headwind
triggers.quote: Volume was down three points, including a roughly two-point headwind from the base period trade inventory impacts

triggers.label: Capex up to add capacity
triggers.quote: this includes an increase in capital spending as we add capacity in several categories

triggers.label: Usage and volume flat to slow
triggers.quote: Usage volume growth is slow. To honestly flat if you look at the front half of the year.

guidance.quote: we continue to expect organic sales growth of in line to plus 4%
This equates to a range of €6.83 to $7.09 per share.
We continue to forecast adjusted free cash flow productivity in the range of 85% to 90% for the year
a core effective tax rate in the range of 20% to 21%, for fiscal 'twenty-six
Expect to pay around $10 billion in dividends and to repurchase approximately $5 billion in common stock.

red_flags.label: Global market share down 20bp; US share loss
red_flags.quote: Global market share down 20 basis points

red_flags.label: Grooming margin down ~300bp on volume deleverage
red_flags.quote: operating margin contracted by almost 300 basis points

red_flags.label: Rising promotion share and layered couponing
red_flags.quote: It doesn't capture forward gift cards. It doesn't capture layered couponing.

evasions.quote: At the risk of disappointing you I will not give you margin guidance for the back half.
let us get through the next two quarters. And focus on acceleration.
